note: Example 1 is the Modesto public-supply well PSW-1. SF6 cache independently reproduces to floating-point precision with left-held half-year inputs and an exact shifted exponential integral. Original 3He(trit) and 3H0 caches do not satisfy isotope mass balance and are not valid parity targets; they are omitted. Fitted parameters use an older input-curve vintage and are contextual starting values, not unique groundwater ages. Original examples do not supply the uncertainties needed by this application. The loaded 5% (minimum 0.05) uncertainty values are illustrative weighting scales; replace them before statistical interpretation. Only selected observations share the fitted model.
